title: REQ · AdminApp runs execution actions, reloads, shows errors and returns to the token gate on 401
summary: AdminApp passes approve, retry and reject handlers to ExecutionPanel
description: AdminApp calls approveExecution, retryExecution and rejectExecution with the token, increments reloads on success, shows failures through actionError and routes 401 to the token gate via handleError.
acceptance_criteria: Given each action succeeds, when clicked, then the matching endpoint is called and executions are fetched again
Given a 401, when an action is clicked, then the token gate shows 'Invalid token'
Given a non-401 failure, when an action is clicked, then an alert shows the error message

preserve: Existing round actions and loading effect

technical_constraints: Reuse handleError and the reloads counter in AdminApp.tsx
